verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly documents an llms.txt endpoint ('For AI agents: visit https://docs.mercury.com/llms.txt for an index of all pages formatted in Markdown and endpoints in OpenAPI. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version') and this was independently confirmed via a live probe returning HTTP 200 with the expected content. This directly satisfies the story of pointing an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent confirmation that the OpenAPI file referenced alongside llms.txt is actually reachable (probe found candidate OpenAPI paths 404), which slightly undercuts the completeness of the agent-oriented doc surface.
